observation: Flat body and section labels are 10–12px tall. At that size a typeface cannot be identified glyph by glyph. Letter width/height is about 0.6–0.8, far wider than the display face (O is 0.40, I is 0.15). That proportion is a semi-condensed grotesque, which is what Saira Semi Condensed is. Saira stays the body family. No custom body glyphs.
